codeReview.summary: Clean, well-structured implementation of SHA-256 checksum verification for the Ghidra installer. The worker added a hardcoded EXPECTED_SHA256 constant sourced from the official NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra GitHub release, implemented chunked hash computation via calculate_sha256(), and a verify_archive_checksum() function that deletes corrupt archives and raises a descriptive ValueError on mismatch. The checksum is verified after download but before extraction in install_ghidra(). Tests cover both the pass path (mocked matching hash) and fail path (mocked mismatched hash with archive deletion), plus the existing download/extract test was updated to set a matching checksum for its synthetic archive. All 6 tests pass. The from __future__ import annotations import ensures the str | None union type hint is compatible with the documented Python 3.9+ requirement.

issues.description: verify_archive_checksum() has an archive_path.exists() guard before unlink(), but the file was just read by calculate_sha256() moments earlier so it should always exist at this point. The guard is harmless defensive code, not a bug.

In test_install_ghidra_extracts_downloaded_distribution, the test patches installer.EXPECTED_SHA256 with the real hash of the synthetic archive. This couples the test to the module-level constant mutation pattern rather than using the expected_sha256 parameter of verify_archive_checksum(). Functional and correct, but slightly fragile if the module is later changed to be immutable.

summary: The add-ghidra-checksum feature is correctly implemented. The hardcoded SHA-256 was sourced from the official GitHub release via `gh release view`. The calculate_sha256() function reads in 1MB chunks, verify_archive_checksum() properly deletes corrupt files and raises ValueError, and the checksum is verified between download and extraction in install_ghidra(). Two dedicated tests mock hashlib.sha256 to cover both pass and fail paths, and the existing download test was updated for compatibility. All 6 tests pass. No blocking issues found.
